operation_intent: Record a staff member's decision and suggestion for a repair request in its approval history.
preconditions_nl: The repair identified by rid exists.
The staff member identified by sid exists.
postconditions_nl: A new approval-history entry is created.
The entry records the supplied reject value.
The entry records the supplied suggestion.
The entry is stored among approval-history records.
The entry is added to the repair's history.
The repair remains stored in the system.
The operation returns the new history entry.
When reject is true, an incoming repair process of 0 and staff role of 1 advance the repair to process 1.
When reject is true, an incoming repair process of 1 and staff role of 2 advance the repair to process 2.
When reject is true, an incoming repair process of 2 and staff role of 3 advance the repair to process 3.
When reject is false, set the repair process to rejection stage 5.

- When reject is true, an incoming repair process of 2 and staff role of 3 advance the repair to process 3.
- When reject is false, set the repair process to rejection stage 5.

operation_intent: Record a repair requester's score and feedback for a finished repair.
preconditions_nl: The staff member identified by sid is the person who raised the repair identified by id.
The staff member has ground-staff role value 0.
The repair is in finished process state 7.
postconditions_nl: The repair records the supplied score.
If the score is at least 3, the repair is marked closed.
If the score is below 3, the repair is marked not closed.
If the score is below 3, the repair description becomes the supplied des text.
If the score is below 3, the repair returns to process state 0.
The repair remains stored in the system.
The operation returns true.

- The repair is in finished process state 7.

Postconditions:
- The repair records the supplied score.
- If the score is at least 3, the repair is marked closed.
- If the score is below 3, the repair is marked not closed.
- If the score is below 3, the repair description becomes the supplied des text.
- If the score is below 3, the repair returns to process state 0.
- The repair remains stored in the system.
- The operation returns true.

operation_intent: Process a librarian's checkout request for the user and book copy identified by uid and barcode.
preconditions_nl: A user with the supplied uid exists.
A book copy with the supplied barcode exists.
The user's borrowing status is NORMAL.
The user's remaining suspension days equal zero.
If the selected user is a BACHELOR student, that student has fewer than 20 loans.
If the selected user is a MASTER student, that student has fewer than 40 loans.
If the selected user is a student whose programme is neither BACHELOR nor MASTER, that student has fewer than 60 loans.
For a non-student user, the faculty record with that uid has fewer than 60 loans.
The selected copy's status is AVAILABLE or ONHOLDSHELF.
If the selected copy is ONHOLDSHELF, it is marked as reserved.
If the selected copy is ONHOLDSHELF, an open reservation links this copy to this user.
postconditions_nl: Create a new loan record.
Link the new loan to the selected user.
Link the new loan to the selected copy.
Mark the new loan as not returned.
Set the loan date to today.
Increase the user's loan count by one relative to its value before checkout.
Add the new loan to the user's loans.
Add the new loan to the copy's loan records.
For a student, set the due date to 30 days after today.
For a non-student, set the due date to 60 days after today.
If the copy was ONHOLDSHELF before checkout, clear its reserved flag.
If the copy was ONHOLDSHELF before checkout, close the matching open reservation for this user and copy.
Set the copy's status to LOANED.
Clear the new loan's three-day overdue flag.
Clear the new loan's ten-day overdue flag.
Clear the new loan's seventeen-day overdue flag.
Clear the new loan's thirty-one-day overdue flag.
Store the new loan among the system's loan records.
Return true.

operation_intent: Renew the selected user's outstanding loan for the selected copy.
preconditions_nl: A user with the supplied uid exists.
The user's borrowing status is NORMAL.
A copy with the supplied barcode exists with status LOANED.
An unreturned loan links this user and copy.
The copy is not reserved.
The loan's due date is later than today.
For a student, the loan has been renewed fewer than three times.
For a non-student, the loan has been renewed fewer than six times.
The loan's overdue fee equals zero.
postconditions_nl: Increase the loan's renewal count by one relative to its value before this operation.
Set the loan's renewal date to today.
For a BACHELOR student, extend the previous due date by 20 days.
For a MASTER student, extend the previous due date by 40 days.
For a student whose programme is neither BACHELOR nor MASTER, extend the previous due date by 60 days.
For a non-student, extend the previous due date by 60 days.
Return true.
description:
Operation intent:
Renew the selected user's outstanding loan for the selected copy.

Preconditions:
- A user with the supplied uid exists.
- The user's borrowing status is NORMAL.
- A copy with the supplied barcode exists with status LOANED.
- An unreturned loan links this user and copy.
- The copy is not reserved.
- The loan's due date is later than today.
- For a student, the loan has been renewed fewer than three times.
- For a non-student, the loan has been renewed fewer than six times.
- The loan's overdue fee equals zero.

Postconditions:
- Increase the loan's renewal count by one relative to its value before this operation.
- Set the loan's renewal date to today.
- For a BACHELOR student, extend the previous due date by 20 days.
- For a MASTER student, extend the previous due date by 40 days.
- For a student whose programme is neither BACHELOR nor MASTER, extend the previous due date by 60 days.
- For a non-student, extend the previous due date by 60 days.
- Return true.
